```{r}
library(here)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
```


Unidad analítica - Biogeográficas (Morrone 202?)
Ver cómo están representadas por distintos tamaños de cuadrícula
¿Cómo quedan representadas por cuadritos con datos?

```{r}
neotropic_provinces <- st_read(here::here("data/in/neotropic_biogeo/Geographic_vector_all/NeotropicMap_Geo.shp"))

mexico <- st_read(here::here("data/in/cni250kgw/cni250kgw.shp"))


#La capa de provincias tiene geometrias invalidas, por lo que se tienen que arreglar.
st_is_valid(neotropic_provinces)
neotropic_prov_valid <- st_make_valid(neotropic_provinces)
st_is_valid(neotropic_prov_valid)

#Cortar la capa de provincias para quedarnos solo con Mexico 

provincias_mexico <- st_intersection(neotropic_prov_valid, mexico)


```


15 km → ~0.135°
25 km → ~0.225°
35 km → ~0.315°
45 km → ~0.405°
50 km → ~0.450°

```{r}
# Define grid sizes in degrees
grid_sizes_deg <- c(0.135, 0.225, 0.315, 0.405, 0.450)

# Get bounding box of the region
bbox <- st_bbox(biogeo_region)

# Function to create a grid with a given degree size
create_grid_deg <- function(degree_size) {
  grid <- st_make_grid(biogeo_regions, cellsize = degree_size, square = TRUE)
  
  # Convert to sf object
  grid_sf <- st_sf(geometry = st_sfc(grid, crs = st_crs(biogeo_regions)))
  
  return(grid_sf)
}

# Generate grids for each degree size
grids <- lapply(grid_sizes_deg, create_grid_deg)

# Name the list elements
names(grids) <- paste0("grid_", grid_sizes_deg, "deg")
```

Measure the proportion 

```{r}

# Perform intersection between each grid and the biogeographic regions
intersect_grids <- lapply(grids, function(grid) {
  st_intersection(grid, biogeo_regions)
})


representation_counts <- lapply(intersect_grids, function(inter_grid) {
  inter_grid %>%
    group_by(JJM2017) %>%  # Replace "region_id" with the actual column name for regions
    summarise(n_cells = n())  # Count grid cells per region
})

# Print results for a specific grid (e.g., 25 km)
print(representation_counts$grid_0.225deg)



```
